source.label: Wizards U.S. Nationals 2008 coverage, "Feature: Vintage Championship Top 8 Coverage" (Bill Stark)

notes.text: Held at Magic Weekend / the 2008 U.S. National Championship in Chicago, not at Gen Con.
Date: the Vintage Swiss ran alongside Nationals Day 2 and the Top 8 coverage was posted with the Nationals Top 8 on Sunday 3 August; mtgtop8 also dates it 03/08/08. The coverage gives no exact day.

Archetypes are the "Deck:" entries in the coverage's player profiles. Finishes from the quarterfinal, semifinal and final reports; seeds are not given. The coverage says only "well over a hundred players".
